question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word. **

The doctor reassured Raman that the lump was __benign__, which brought immense relief to both him and his family.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Malignant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
• The given word is "**benign**" which means not harmful. (हानिकारक नहीं)
 
 
• **Example**: *The doctor assured her that the tumour was benign and not cancerous.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of "benign" is "**malignant**" which means harmful. (हानिकारक)
 
 
• **Example**: *Unfortunately, the biopsy revealed that the growth was malignant, requiring immediate treatment.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word is "malignant".

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harsh **means unpleasant or unkind. (अप्रिय या निर्दयी)
 
• **Rugged **means rough or uneven. (खुरदुरा या असमान)
 
• **Healthy **means in good physical or mental condition. (अच्छी शारीरिक या मानसिक स्थिति)
